summary:
Mars Exploration Project Summary
Our Canva presentation introduces Mars through NASA missions such as Phoenix, Viking 1, Pathfinder, and Perseverance. It uses a map to show where the spacecraft landed and what they studied at each site. The presentation also includes a guided virtual tour using the Little Astronomy 3D Mars Map, so students can explore the Martian surface together. Through this project, we aim to spark curiosity about space exploration and practice sharing scientific ideas in English.
details:
Our project takes students on a virtual tour of Mars. Using a map of NASA’s landing sites, we show where missions such as Phoenix, Viking 1, Pathfinder, and Perseverance landed and what they studied. We then guide the class through the Little Astronomy 3D Mars Map so students can explore the planet’s surface and connect each mission to a real place on Mars.

The tour helps students understand why different missions went to different places and what scientists hoped to learn at each site. It also gives us a chance to practice English by researching space exploration and explaining what we learned. We hope the project encourages students to ask their own questions about Mars and become more curious about science.

We used Canva to create our presentation and the Little Astronomy 3D Mars Map to guide the tour. The creative part of our project is that the class explores Mars one landing site at a time, with each stop telling the story of a different6 mission. When designing the tour, we considered which missions to include, how to explain their discoveries in clear English, and how to make the map easy for our classmates to follow.
